caption: The drawing features a single, detailed boot and two simplified shoe outlines. The boot is positioned on the right side of the composition, depicted in profile view facing left. It is rendered in a light beige or tan color, with subtle shading that suggests the texture of soft leather or fabric. The boot has a pointed toe and a high ankle extending above the ankle joint. The front facing part of the boot includes a series of evenly spaced eyelets through which light-colored laces are threaded in a zig-zag pattern, mostly closed except for a slight opening near the top where one lace end is visible. On the left upper side of the drawing are two lightly sketched, outline-only views of the shoe from above, showing the top and bottom contours with no shading or interior details. The background is an unadorned, pale neutral beige and the entire drawing is executed on a lightly textured paper.
title: Woman's Shoe
